front.title: AI Safety for Radio Network Observation and Control Calculation Consistency

abstract.t: Part 02 of 15 describes AI safety for distributed radio-access- network observation and control calculation consistency. A radio controller may receive independently valid telemetry that is jointly unsuitable for the same calculation because it refers to different cell or beam identities, configuration generations, clock domains, acquisition intervals, measurement units, aggregation semantics, or shared upstream evidence. This document develops A-CW-01 and six specialized procedures for source-qualified temporal consistency, resource reassignment, measurement transformation, dependency-aware observation selection, coupled multi-resource decisions, and controller failover. It specifies evidence-scoped supported, contradicted, and unresolved outcomes, with revalidation after material state changes. The result qualifies a calculation; it does not independently authorize modification of live radio resources. Companion Parts 01, 03, 04, 05, 11, and 14 address shared evidence semantics, network recovery, service state, hardware observations, migration, and optional protected effectuation boundaries.
